title: Vofpen.
text: “Uh, um…… well……”

Mole was trying to make a proposal so as not to lose to those guys, but the words were getting stuck in her throat. It’s hopeless after all! I could almost hear Big Sister’s voice saying so, but Mole was gonna do her best, ribbit!
“Is there anywhere you’d like to go, Imiya-chan? Itsuki left this to me, after all.”
“Um, well……”
Mole turned to look at Crocodile Guy and the others.
“Shion, Theo, Wolf too — don’t you dare scare Imiya-chan, got it?”
“Understood.”
“Please don’t misunderstand us.”
“Vofpen, that is not our intention.”

Big Sister and Mole inside my head kept insisting over and over — This is completely out of place! The defenses are too strong, there’s no way in! Please don’t force her! — but Father had been asked by Itsuki to look after Mole, so he did. Incidentally, it seemed that afterward Mole ended up asking Itsuki and Ren for stomach medicine.
“Anyway, for Itsuki’s sake and his romantic prospects, I hope you have fun too, Imiya-chan.”
“Y-yes……”
“Alright then! Let’s see if we can’t make Imiya-chan strong while we’re on this island!”

I don’t think this is about levels or anything like that — I don’t think she can become strong as a person! — was the expression I thought I saw on Mole’s face, but Father and the others headed off anyway. Father, feeling bad that he hadn’t been able to spend much time with her, played with Mole while they were on the island. And then for some reason Itsuki took Father along with Mole and the others on an outing. The slaves were left behind to watch the house during this — it seemed Itsuki had kicked them out, in fact.
“As if we ever intended anything like that.”
“Honestly, how rude. What exactly have we done?”
“Vofuppen. Do it like this, it’ll be fine.”
“Wolf-san, please stop trying to curry favor.”
Crocodile Guy and the others seemed to be having their own troubles.
“Fuffufu, ribbit.”
“What is it, Spear Hero? Why are you approaching with that smug look on your face?”
“I hear you’ve been ordered to stay behind and mind the house, ribbit. Any idea why, ribbit?”
“There’s absolutely no value in consulting you, so could you please go play with the Filolials instead?”
Rabbit Guy waved a hand at me, shooing me away.
“Now, now, ribbit. I think Father is just taking Mole and the others along to look after Itsuki, ribbit. Surely Itsuki only brought them because he trusts Mole and Father, ribbit.”
“That’s not far from the truth, I suppose…… but for some reason it seems we’re being viewed as if we were threatening Imiya.”
I see, ribbit. So they suspected jealousy, did they?
“HAHAHA! If it’s Mole, that’s fine, ribbit. Far better than Father’s first time being taken by Rival, ribbit.”

If anything, given that possibility, I’d rather root for it, ribbit. That way, Mole’s spirit might just shield me when Big Sister gets angry at me. Completely self-serving, you say? No, not at all, ribbit. My answer seemed to displease them, and Crocodile Guy and the others knit their brows.
“Consulting this man really was a mistake after all.”
“Well, given how noisy he is about the Shield Hero’s ‘experience,’ I suppose I don’t mind either way…… I see, perhaps it’s worth making that clear to Imiya as well.”
“Ah…… I have no complaints on that front either. It’s something Iwatani-sama will eventually need, and he shouldn’t be monopolized, should he? He is the great Shield Hero, after all.”
“Vof.”
“Rather, isn’t the real issue how we avoid coming across as overbearing to Imiya and the others? I feel like the Rumo-species folk find us intimidating.”
“Even in demi-human form, the height difference and Shion’s trained muscles give off quite the pressure, don’t they?”
“That’s why, vof.”
Kyurun! Wolf, in peckul form, tilted his head cutely with sparkling eyes, trying to curry favor.
“I think Wolf’s trying way too hard to curry favor, don’t you? In contrast, how about me? Neither in demi-human nor beastman form do I give off any sense of intimidation.”
“Heh……”
Crocodile Guy let out a small laugh at Rabbit Guy’s words.
“What is it?”
“You sometimes have a sharp look in your eyes, don’t you? Did you think no one noticed?”
“Was I making that kind of face? I suppose it’s less that I’m unaware and more that I’m easily misunderstood. It’s not about appearance, then.”
“You have that cool sort of face, and then you stare sometimes — that’s why people get that impression.”
At Crocodile Guy’s words, Rabbit Guy’s brow furrowed in trouble.
“That’s a difficult problem.”
“That part’s fine as it is. What we need to ask is whether he’ll allocate some time for us amid the island activities.”
“True. It would be a problem for us too if he were with them the entire time.”
“Peen! Trying to sneak in and curry favor, vof.”
“Spear Hero, Wolf’s trying to cut ahead of us.”
“What did you say!”
“Vofu!?”
I caught Wolf in my usaunny form, ribbit!
“Well, so long as we make our proposal properly, I’m sure he’ll be considerate about it.”
“That much is certain. He seems especially conscious of not making anyone hold back on account of their position.”
Father really is quite considerate in that way. Incidentally, in cases where Father couldn’t help me out, I simply factored in a priority order.
“Kind Father makes sure not to unconsciously think things like ‘be patient because you’re the older one,’ ribbit.”
“Vofu, younger sibling privilege, not permitted.”
“Come to think of it, Wolf-san, didn’t you have an older brother? How was that, exactly?”
“Vof, didn’t care about such things, laid-back brother. Head not so smart, so always my job.”
“Despite sounding like the put-upon type, there’s no trace of that in you now.”
“Vofuppeen.”
Wolf puffed out his chest as if triumphant about something.
“Enjoying yourself, huh…… well, I do understand how attentive he is.”
“Looking forward to the tropical date, so learning everything about this place for that purpose.”
“Well, that’s probably the safe answer……”

“Shall we go scout out the main island, then…… good shops for Imiya-san, date spots, that sort of thing. I really do wish Bow Hero would get some experience already. If he does, it might raise the odds of him settling down and finally calming down.”

Somehow, Wolf and the rest of Crocodile Guy’s group trooped off toward the market to do their research. Heh…… do you lot really think you can surpass my perfect date course, crafted from having mastered every inch of Cal Mira Island? Secure this route, and there’s a breathtaking course that would make even an angel fall head over heels, ribbit! Mind you, it’s the improved version now, since Big Sister scolded me for the original, ribbit. I’ll be watching from far, far above. Watching to see whether you lot can construct a course capable of giving Father a good time! Ribbit!
“Somehow that man’s triumphant face is incredibly infuriating.”
“What an incomprehensible fellow.”
“Shall we clear up Imiya-san’s misunderstanding just to spite him? Or perhaps have Iwatani-sama spend time with someone like Larsazusa-san, given her species and looks might be more to his taste.”
“In the first place, isn’t Gaelion the root cause of that man’s ruckus?”

“It seems disinterested, or rather, feels far older than its age — I sense quite a bit of intelligence there. I’d wager it’s older than our parents. Certainly easier to talk to than Rafumi, who’s always making jokes that aren’t even funny.”
“Vofu.”
“That said, even if we sicced it on him and it worked, the rest of us across the other worlds would suffer for it, so it’s best we don’t poke at it carelessly.”

So saying, the slaves headed out to survey the island’s tourist spots. After that, it seemed they took turns going out with Father day by day. Incidentally, every night I did my peeping and worked to raise little Yuki-chan’s charm level, ribbit. In usaunny form, the success rate was remarkably high, ribbit! Well…… only in that form, though, Father inside my memories muttered.
